description: This file defines and registers various binary kernel operations for Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) backend in PyTorch, specifically for use with Apple's GPU acceleration. It includes kernel implementation functions, dispatch registration, and references external shader libraries.

methods.name: binary_op_kernel
methods.description: Performs a binary operation kernel on input tensors, resizing output if necessary, and invokes the corresponding GPU kernel via lib.exec_binary_kernel.

methods.name: fmax_mps_kernel
methods.description: Kernel for maximum operation, uses floating-point specific GPU kernel if type is floating, otherwise calls CPU maximum.

methods.description: Kernel for minimum operation, similar to fmax_mps_kernel.
